name: objekte/raetsel_ball
where: Spur 12 — загадка Оскара «жёлтое, круглое, с дырками, для мыши»
text:
Use the attached images as the exact reference for characters and style. Same children's picture-book style. Plain warm white background, no text, no letters, no numbers, no stars. Every item clearly separated from the others with empty space around it, so it can be cut out. Soft hand-painted picture-book look (watercolor and colored pencil) like the attached images – NOT flat vector clip-art, no glossy 3D look.
One object, centered, slightly from above: a classic football (soccer ball), drawn simply and cleanly like in a children's picture book: a perfectly round white ball with a REGULAR pattern of black pentagons, soft shading, no distorted or broken patches.
redo: Мяч нарисован криво: пятна разной формы, выглядит сломанным. Нужен простой аккуратный мяч с ровным узором.
